checks.name: diagnostic_risk_atom_chain_closure
checks.interpretation: Every numerical case reaches a recorded release boundary, mass ledger, dispersion/pool, cloud, ignition-damage stage and four branch-specific risk atoms. Operator-limited cases remain diagnostic and do not qualify the provider or facility QRA.

checks.name: diagnostic_equipment_state_release_chain
checks.interpretation: Each numerical facility case retains the equipment state, provider packet, release termination and digest identity. Operator-limited cases remain diagnostic and do not qualify provider evidence or facility QRA.

checks.name: diagnostic_facility_frequency_uncertainty_closure
checks.interpretation: Literature p05/p95 and fixed-rate scenarios reproduce the saved conditional IR/F-N sensitivity. No missing frequency is inferred and no fresh physics is run.

checks.name: diagnostic_facility_component_contribution_closure
